domain.description: Synthetic UK water customer, asset, leakage incident, repair work order, inspection, service interruption, and operational performance analytics for a Fabric Data Agent hackathon.

entities.name: Customer
entities.grain: one synthetic water service account holder

entities.name: Asset
entities.grain: one synthetic maintainable water infrastructure asset

entities.name: Incident
entities.grain: one synthetic leakage or service interruption incident affecting one primary asset and optionally one customer

entities.name: Work Order
entities.grain: one synthetic repair work order belonging to one incident

entities.name: Inspection
entities.grain: one synthetic inspection of one asset

relationships: A Customer may have many Incidents through customer_id; an Incident may affect no individual customer.
An Asset has many Incidents through asset_id, and each Incident has one primary Asset.
An Incident has many Work Orders through incident_id, and each Work Order belongs to one Incident.
An Asset has many Inspections through asset_id, and each Inspection belongs to one Asset.

metrics.name: Open Incidents
metrics.definition: Count of incidents whose status is Open or Investigating.

metrics.name: Total Estimated Leakage
metrics.definition: Sum of estimated_leakage_m3 for incidents whose status is Open or Investigating.

metrics.name: Average Repair Duration
metrics.definition: Average elapsed hours from work_started_at to work_completed_at for completed work orders only.

metrics.name: Repeat Incidents
metrics.definition: Count of incidents whose asset had another incident with an earlier opened_at timestamp in the prior 30 days.

metrics.name: Work Completed On Time
metrics.definition: Percentage of completed work orders whose work_completed_at is on or before promised_completion_at.

metrics.name: Assets Requiring Attention
metrics.definition: Distinct count of active assets with either an open Critical or High incident or a latest inspection result of Failed.

metrics.name: Customers Affected
metrics.definition: Distinct count of customers linked to an Open or Investigating incident.

metrics.name: Service Interruption Hours
metrics.definition: Sum of service_interruption_hours across all incidents.

terminology.customer: Synonym for account holder in this demonstration.
terminology.account holder: Synonym for customer in this demonstration.
terminology.incident: May also be called an event or issue.
terminology.repair: Work performed through a work order; repair and work order are related but are not synonyms.
terminology.high severity: An incident whose severity is Critical or High.
terminology.active incident: An incident whose status is Open or Investigating.

dataRules: Generate deterministic synthetic UK data with a fixed random seed and fixed dataset dates.
Use fictional identifiers, names, broad regions, and postcode areas only.
Do not use real customer identities, full addresses, precise infrastructure locations, credentials, or vulnerability details.
Maintain referential integrity and calculate evaluation answers directly from generated CSVs.
safetyRules: The agent may summarize synthetic demonstration data but must not direct safety-critical field operations.
The agent must not expose credentials, precise infrastructure locations, vulnerability details, or claim live operational status.
The agent must not claim regulatory compliance or replace approved operational, safety, or regulatory processes.
All outputs must identify the records as synthetic when they could be mistaken for live operational data.
